how: Open each path, press #sample, read '.verdict p:last-child'; it must start with 'expect'. The sample runs free; the visitor's own file needs a signed 3-day trial code (FK1...). Client copies carry a preset code (3 days from first use, hard limit 31 Dec 2026). Each 'why' is a dated fact: re-check its source and replace it once it is no longer true.
